# VNVE Skill

> An Agent Skill for creating editable visual novels and dialogue videos from text. A standalone local CLI manages projects; a browser editor previews, edits and exports MP4.

VNVE（视觉故事创作）用于把故事、角色对白和剧本组织成本地可编辑作品。This index links to the repository's human-readable source documentation; it does not replace runtime schemas.

## Project facts

- Input: story text, dialogue or a structured script, plus optional user media.
- Output: editable local projects and shared media; MP4 is encoded in the browser.
- Host Agent: story adaptation, media search or generation, TTS and CLI execution. WorkBuddy is one demonstrated host, not a requirement of the project format.
- Local browser editor: preview, direct adjustments, autosave and MP4 export. The editor does not host a creative Agent or a cloud generation gateway.
- Visual performance: characters, expressions, blocking, cameras, transitions, weather, comic cut-ins, introductions and custom layered animation.
- Custom performance: the host can write deterministic animation algorithms and bake them into numerical tracks. The browser plays validated data rather than creative scripts.
- Media: optional starter assets, imported user media or assets generated through host-selected services. TTS and image generation may incur provider fees; opening projects and saving settings do not trigger paid calls.
- Storage: projects and shared media are local; provider credentials are stored separately in user-level settings, not in project files.
- Installation: Skill and CLI are distributed separately. `npx skills add vnve/skills --skill vnve` installs the Skill. The installer needs Node.js; the standalone CLI does not need Node.js, Bun or a source checkout to run.
- Compatibility: consult skills/vnve/cli.json and actual GitHub Release assets; do not infer platform availability from build targets alone.

## Creation and editing

- [Production](skills/vnve/references/production.md): story beats, dialogue timing and delivery checks.
- [Common visual effects](skills/vnve/references/common-effects.md): standard performance entry points and camera choices.
- [Special performance](skills/vnve/references/performance.md): comic, duel, introductions, memory and subjective awakening.
- [Custom animation](skills/vnve/references/animation.md): deterministic timeline and numerical-track workflow.
- [Visual primitives](skills/vnve/references/visual-primitives.md): layers, masks, blending and particles.
- [Media and audio](skills/vnve/references/media.md): image, sound, font and voice imports.
- [TTS services](skills/vnve/references/services.md): supported provider configuration and credential boundaries.
- [Dialogue themes](skills/vnve/references/dialogue.md): dialogue layout and typography.
- [Editing](skills/vnve/references/editing.md): validated atomic patches and project editing.
